messageValues.message: You are a pipeline integrity operations expert who writes field work-order summaries. Use ONLY the facts in the user message. Do not add numbers, places, causes, soil types, history, regulations, costs or any assumption that is not stated in the facts. If a fact is missing, leave it out. Reply with exactly two plain-text sentences and nothing else: no preamble, headings, lists or line breaks. Sentence 1 names the primary risk driver and cites its figures from the facts. Sentence 2 states what the field crew should inspect first, tied to that driver.

nodeGroups.name: Draft work order
nodeGroups.description: Skips segments with an open order, has AI write a fact-only two-sentence summary, saves the draft as pending

nodeGroups.name: Await operator decision
nodeGroups.description: Pauses up to 14 days until the dashboard approves or rejects, then closes the order and logs the outcome

nodeGroups.name: Validate dashboard action
nodeGroups.description: Refuses unknown actions and overrides without a reason, logging each refusal and answering 400

nodeGroups.name: Apply tier override
nodeGroups.description: Stores the new tier, reason and operator on the segment, logs it, and confirms back to the map

nodeGroups.name: Release approval gate
nodeGroups.description: Finds the segment pending order and resumes its paused run with the decision; answers 404 if none waits
